hotels.title: NSW Tweed Coast Mantra Beachside Escape Just 30 Minutes from Byron Bay with Lagoon-Style Pool
hotels.description: This is your invitation to discover one of the region's best-kept secrets: embrace surfside serenity with a family-friendly beachside stay located on New South Wales' spectacular Tweed Coast, just 30 minutes from Byron Bay. Mantra on Salt Beach Kingscliff occupies a prime position in Salt Village - the charming coastal town of Kingscliff's retail and dining precinct - and with direct access to Salt Beach's balmy sands, you'll be all set to enjoy the good life.

hotels.title: Kingscliff Coastal Luxury Just 45 Minutes from Byron Bay with Daily Breakfast & A$100 Dining Credit
hotels.description: Settle into the sun-soaked rhythm of the Tweed Coast at Peppers Salt Resort & Spa Kingscliff, just a brisk one-hour drive from Byron Bay. This luxury resort is one of New South Wales' best-kept secrets, sitting moments from the powdery beachfront and providing a family-friendly launchpad to explore this enchanting corner of Australia. Days here tend to find their own rhythm. Mornings begin with a decadent breakfast at Season Restaurant before The Spa at Salt takes over - unwind in the Tranquillity Lounge first, indulge in your treatment, then finish with the hydrotherapy spa. Come afternoon, the lagoon-style pool and its sandy beach do the rest, with Cove Bar on hand to keep the drinks flowing between dips. When the pull of the outdoors wins out, you're well positioned for it: surf at Kingscliff Beach, kayak or paddleboard on the Tweed River or head inland to explore World Heritage-listed national parks and their walking trails.

hotels.title: Coastal Kingscliff Escape 20 Minutes from Tweed Heads with Pools, Restaurant & Tennis Courts
hotels.description: For all the charm of a seaside village combined with the luxury of one of Australia's leading resort brands, enjoy a stay at Peppers Salt Resort & Spa Kingscliff. Just minutes from the pristine Salt Beach and surrounded by lush hinterland, choose to laze the day away along the shore, in the resort's sparkling pool, or enjoy a friendly hit of tennis. Savour locally-sourced cuisine at the onsite Season restaurant, rejuvenate at the world-class Spa At Salt, or explore the nearby boutique shops and cafes.
